newsitem.title: LEBANON: Lebanon's Jan/Feb budget deficit 563.3 bln pounds.
newsitem.headline: Lebanon's Jan/Feb budget deficit 563.3 bln pounds.

text.p: Lebanon's budget deficit reached 563.3 billion Lebanese pounds in the first two months of 1997, according to finance ministry statistics issued on Thursday.
The February deficit of revenue against expenditure rose to 309.7 billion pounds from 253.6 billion in January.
The 1997 budget envisages income of 4,100 billion pounds against expenditure of 6,433 billion.
The ministry issued the following statistics (in billions of Lebanese pounds at end of period):
$1= 1,547.75 Lebanese pound at end of February
$1= 1,549.75 Lebanese pound at end of January
